page.notes: Printed line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 stand in the right margin; they are kept as notes. The left margin figure "Dcec." beside "finibus" is doubtful and copied as printed. The mark after "hæc," is an unclear sign; a [?] stands in its place. "dicere tur" and "eamarcem" are printed with the spacing and spelling shown, and are left as they are. "Dcec." and "LIV." may also be read as one pair across the line "Adriani,", but they are placed as the layout shows them.
